name: orchflows-firstmate
description: Orchflows for FirstMate: fresh FirstMate agents for Work and Review, composed into reusable workflows with per-agent model and effort.

interface.shortDescription: Work and independent Review with FirstMate agents.
interface.longDescription: Composable delegation workflows and layered guidance for a FirstMate primary session. Every Work and Review is an ordinary FirstMate crewmate or scout; nothing in FirstMate is patched.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the workflow the captain names; otherwise run orch-dynamic-workflow.
